findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_iclips" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: iclips_financial_entries_list, iclips_financial_entries_get · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: iclips_jobs_delete, iclips_pieces_delete, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: iclips_financial_entries_list, iclips_financial_entries_get · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: iclips_jobs_delete, iclips_pieces_delete, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
